title: CN/V20261019 explicit battle predicates
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 SHA256 27bda43d8cb78ed800891c6793e5efd945ac64d94a83ceff8adaed10e8f67419: II.A PDF p19, II.B-01..03 p19–20, II.D-15..17 p50–51 (one-based). Actual conditions require the reviewed card binding's sourceOfTruth; this syntax is not card approval. Values use exact integer arithmetic, not coercion. Validate the full static AST before short-circuiting runtime logic; unresolved facts must not become false/zero. The host supplies plain normalized facts; missing/getter holders are not explicit null.

sharedType.description: 「自己场上，有与对手场上宝可梦相同属性的宝可梦」 (own field, opponent field) / 「双方的战斗宝可梦为相同属性」 (active, active): some Pokémon of the effect user's and some of the opponent's, in those spots, have a current type in common (属性相同 as in the Weakness step, I p7).

compare.description: Compare two exact signed integers. No final damage clamp or safe-Number conversion is applied to intermediate Values.

exists.description: Only an explicit null holder is absent. Missing, inherited, hidden, accessor or non-record holders are invalid facts, never false.

pokemonIs.description: Whether one holder matches a Pokémon selector (current types), an in-play state and/or a position (「这只宝可梦在战斗场上／在备战区」). A missing holder is an invalid fact, never false.

stadiumInPlay.description: Whether a Stadium is in play, put into play by the effect user (own), the opponent, or anyone (any), optionally matching a Trainer selector.

historyFact.description: Battle-history facts of the effect user, judged on the user's own turn: previousOpponentKnockout (II.E-11, one of the user's Pokémon was Knocked Out during the previous opponent turn; cause attackDamage = by attack damage), movedToActive (II.E-24, this Pokémon moved from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn), supporterPlayed (II.E-25, the user played a Supporter from hand this turn, optionally matching a selector), healed (II.E-26, this Pokémon's HP was healed this turn), evolvedThisTurn (II.E-23, this Pokémon evolved this turn; selector = the Pokémon card it evolved from), firstOwnTurn / secondPlayerFirstTurn (I.A-05, it is now the user's own first turn / and the user went second), toolFromHand (I.A-01 turn actions, I.B-02: the user attached a Tool from hand to this Pokémon this turn).

selector.description: II.E-11 「自己的【X】宝可梦／「Y」【昏厥】」: only a Knocked Out Pokémon whose printed top card (its latched Knock Out receipt) matches.

oneOf.description: otherEvolvedFromHand (II.E-23): 「在自己的回合，如果从手牌使出宝可梦使自己的其他「X」进行进化了的话」 — this turn, while this Pokémon was in play, another of the user's Pokémon evolved into a card played from the hand; selector = the Pokémon card it evolved from.

previousOwnAttack: in the user's previous own turn one of the user's Pokémon used an attack (I.A-01); by self = this Pokémon (「这只宝可梦使用了」), other = another of the user's Pokémon (「这只宝可梦以外的…」), any = any of them (「自己的宝可梦使用了」); selector = the user's printed card identity; attackNames = the printed attack names (「使用了「X」」).
specialRuleUsed: 「如果自己／对手已经使用了GX招式／VSTAR力量的话」 (that player's once-per-game rule is spent).
previousOpponentSpecialAttack: 「在上一个对手的回合，如果对手的宝可梦使用了GX招式」.

previousOpponentMove: during the user's latest opponent turn, the opponent's Pokémon who (the opponent's Active, or the damaged target) went to the Bench by Retreat (「在上一个对手的回合，如果那只宝可梦从战斗场撤退了」, move retreat) or was moved from the Bench to the Active Spot (「…对手的战斗宝可梦，是从备战区被放于战斗场上」, move benchToActive), and has not evolved or devolved since (I.A-03, II.E-24, JP Q&A).
